title: Grove
description: MCP-compatible agentic memory service that maintains context continuity across multi-tool AI sessions. RAG pipeline using Qdrant for low-latency semantic retrieval and persistent cross-agent state management.

title: Fitr
description: AI-powered wardrobe management platform. Computer vision pipelines for clothing segmentation, pgvector-based semantic matching for personalized outfit recommendations, and AMD ROCm-optimized local LLM inference.

title: Burrow
description: Self-hosted reverse proxy alternative to Ngrok for secure local service exposure via HTTPS subdomains and TCP tunnels. Dynamic routing, connection multiplexing, and Redis-backed session caching for fast reconnections.

title: Fashion Vision
description: Real-time fashion analysis API and webcam demo powered by Hugging Face Transformers.js. Four ML models for fashion classification, body segmentation, face analysis, and background removal.

title: InkByte
description: End-to-end link shortener with server-side rendering, REST APIs, and database-driven routing. Privacy-first analytics with edge functions for global low-latency and custom branded domains.

title: GoBox
description: File upload and sharing service with HTTP servers, multipart uploads, and filesystem-based storage. Concurrent I/O handling with a jQuery-based frontend for drag-and-drop sharing.

title: Paint OpenGL
description: Interactive paint application built with modern OpenGL. Layer-based editing, brush system, and real-time rendering.
